title: Class Fairness in Model-Heterogeneous Federated Learning: Measurement and a Diagnostic Ladder
description: A measurement study of client-FM versus two-axis (client x class) fairness in model-heterogeneous federated learning, with a diagnostic ladder showing that four standard interventions reduce the class gap by at most 7.9% over one seed. Proposes class-FM as a reporting metric, not a training method.
